+ Bail Appln. 3774/2023
 Adeeba .....

Through: Appearance not given.
 versus  STATE OF NCT OF DELHI .....
 Through: Mr. Hemant Mehla, APP f  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  OR % 08.11.2023 CRL.M.A. 30747/2023 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. The present application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 113/2023 under Sections 498A/406/313/377/354C/34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station Daryaganj.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there are no specific allegations made in the FIR against the present petitioner, who happens to be sister-in-law of the complainant.

5. He also invites the attention of the Court to the order dated 24.05.2023 passed by the learned Sessions Court to contend that the brother of the petitioner, who is the husband of the complainant,
has already been granted interim protection subject to his joining investigation.
6.
He submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation as and This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 03:22:26 when required by the I.O concerned.
7. Issue notice.
The learned APP for the State accepts notice.
8. Let Status Report be filed before the next date.

9. Considering the fact that the husband of the complainant has already been granted interim protection and further regard being had to the fact that the petitioner is an unmarried girl and had also joined investigation earlier, it is directed that till the next date, no coercive action be taken against the petitioner subject to her joining investigation on 10.11.2023 at 02:00 p.m and on subsequent dates as and when required by the I.O concerned.
